block_info.label: QRD
block_info.description: QR Decomposition block targeted for AI Engines using the modified Gram-Schmidt process.

parameters.name: data_type
parameters.description: Type of individual data samples of the input matrix.
parameters.label: Input data type:

parameters.name: row_dimension
parameters.description: Number of rows in the input matrix.
parameters.label: Rows of matrix:

parameters.name: cols_dimension
parameters.description: Number of columns in the input matrix.
parameters.label: Columns of matrix:

parameters.name: num_frames
parameters.description: Number of matrices to decompose per call to the kernel.
parameters.label: Number of frames:

parameters.name: casc_length
parameters.description: Number of kernels to be used to split up and cascade the workload.
parameters.label: Number of cascade stages:

parameters.name: dim_a_leading
parameters.description: Describes which dimension of the Matrix A input data is contigious in memory. TP_DIM_A_LEADING=1 is row major, and TP_DIM_A_LEADING=0 is column major.
parameters.label: A input leading dimension:

parameters.name: dim_q_leading
parameters.description: Describes which dimension of the Matrix Q output data is contigious in memory. TP_DIM_Q_LEADING=1 is row major, and TP_DIM_Q_LEADING=0 is column major.
parameters.label: Q output leading dimension:

parameters.name: dim_r_leading
parameters.description: Describes which dimension of the Matrix R output data is contigious in memory. TP_DIM_R_LEADING=1 is row major, and TP_DIM_R_LEADING=0 is column major.
parameters.label: R output leading dimension:
